nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the intermediate field of $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ generated over $\mathbb{C}$ by the roots $x_1, \dots, x_n$ is the whole function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$.
nodes.title: The roots generate the function field

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the image of the $k$-th elementary symmetric polynomial $e_k \in \mathbb{C}[X_1, \dots, X_n]$ in the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ is the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of the multiset of roots $\{x_1, \dots, x_n\}$, that is, the sum of the products $x_{i_1} \cdots x_{i_k}$ over all $i_1 < \dots < i_k$.
nodes.title: Elementary symmetric polynomials evaluated at the roots

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and every polynomial $p \in \mathbb{C}[X_1, \dots, X_n]$, the image of $p$ in the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ lies in the $\mathbb{C}$-subalgebra generated by the roots $x_1, \dots, x_n$.
nodes.title: Polynomials in the roots

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the coefficients $a_1, \dots, a_n$ of the general polynomial, the elementary symmetric functions of $x_1, \dots, x_n$, are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{C}$ in the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$.
nodes.title: The coefficients are algebraically independent

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the elementary symmetric polynomials $e_1, \dots, e_n \in \mathbb{C}[X_1, \dots, X_n]$ are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Algebraic independence of the elementary symmetric polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebras, let $f : A \to B$ be an injective $\mathbb{C}$-algebra homomorphism, and let $(x_i)_{i \in \iota}$ be a family in $A$ that is algebraically independent over $\mathbb{C}$. Then the family $(f(x_i))_{i \in \iota}$ is algebraically independent over $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Injective algebra maps preserve algebraic independence

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the roots $x_1, \dots, x_n$ are algebraically independent over $\mathbb{C}$ in the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$.
nodes.title: The roots are algebraically independent

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then…
nodes.title: Lower bound for the essential dimension of symmetric groups

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then $\operatorname{ed}(S_n) \le n - 3$ for…
nodes.title: Upper bound for the essential dimension of symmetric groups

nodes.summary: For $0 \le i < n$, the coefficient $a_{i+1}$, the $(i+1)$-st elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$, regarded as an element of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$.
nodes.title: Coefficients in the coefficient field

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, for $1 \le k \le n$ let $a_k$ be the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$ in the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$, and let $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ be the coefficient field. For each natural number $k$, the element $c_k$ of $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ is defined by $c_0 = 1$, $c_k = a_k$ for $1 \le k \le n$, and $c_k = 0$ for $k > n$.
nodes.title: Coefficients indexed by degree

nodes.summary: For $0 \le i < n$, the coefficient $a_{i+1}$ is the $(i+1)$-st elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$, as an element of the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$.
nodes.title: The coefficients of the general polynomial

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then $\operatorname{ed}(S_5) = 2$.
nodes.title: Essential dimension of the symmetric group on five letters

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then $\operatorname{ed}(S_4) = 2$.
nodes.title: Essential dimension of the symmetric group on four letters

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$, in the general-polynomial parameter sense, is at most $n$.
nodes.title: Trivial upper bound for the essential dimension of $S_n$

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then $\operatorname{ed}(S_7) = 4$.
nodes.title: Essential dimension of the symmetric group on seven letters

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then $\operatorname{ed}(S_6) = 3$.
nodes.title: Essential dimension of the symmetric group on six letters

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ be the field of rational functions in $n$ indeterminates. The essential dimension of $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$, in the general-polynomial parameter sense, is the least natural number $d$ such that some intermediate field $F_0$ of $\mathbb{C} \subseteq \mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ of transcendence degree at most $d$ over $\mathbb{C}$ admits an intermediate…
nodes.title: Essential dimension of the symmetric group

nodes.summary: The constant $C_{79}$, the limit superior as $n \to \infty$ of $\operatorname{ed}_{\mathbb{C}}(S_n) / n$ with the essential dimension of $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ taken in the general-polynomial parameter sense, satisfies $C_{79} \le 1$.
nodes.title: The essential-dimension ratio of the symmetric groups is at most one

nodes.summary: Write $\operatorname{ed}(S_n)$ for the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial sense: the least transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ of a subfield $F_0$ of the coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial of degree $n$ over which that polynomial descends up to Tschirnhaus transformation. Then…
nodes.title: Lower bound for the asymptotic essential-dimension ratio

nodes.summary: The catalogue constant $C_{79}$ is the limit superior, as $n \to \infty$, of $\operatorname{ed}_{\mathbb{C}}(S_n) / n$, where $\operatorname{ed}_{\mathbb{C}}(S_n)$ is the essential dimension of the symmetric group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ in the general-polynomial parameter sense.
nodes.title: Asymptotic essential-dimension ratio of the symmetric groups

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ be the field of rational functions in $n$ indeterminates and, for $1 \le k \le n$, let $a_k$ be the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$. The coefficient field $\mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ is the intermediate field of $\mathbb{C} \subseteq \mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ generated over $\mathbb{C}$ by $a_1, \dots, a_n$.
nodes.title: Coefficient field of the general polynomial

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $x_1, \dots, x_n$ be the indeterminates of the rational function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$, let $a_0 = 1$ and, for $1 \le k \le n$, let $a_k$ be the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$. The general polynomial of degree $n$ is the polynomial $\sum_{j=0}^{n} (-1)^j a_j X^{n-j} = X^n - a_1 X^{n-1} + \cdots + (-1)^n a_n$ with coefficients in the coefficient…
nodes.title: General polynomial

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, every element of the field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ of rational functions in $n$ indeterminates is algebraic over the $\mathbb{C}$-subalgebra generated by $x_1, \dots, x_n$: it is a ratio of two polynomials in $x_1, \dots, x_n$.
nodes.title: Rational functions are algebraic over the polynomial subalgebra

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and distinct elements $a \ne b$ of the field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ of rational functions in $n$ indeterminates, the polynomials $X - a$ and $X - b$ are coprime in $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)[X]$: there are polynomials $u$ and $v$ with $u (X - a) + v (X - b) = 1$.
nodes.title: Distinct linear factors are coprime

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the pair $(F, E)$ is a descent of the general polynomial extension, where $E = \mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ is the field of rational functions in $n$ indeterminates and $F = \mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ is the coefficient field, generated over $\mathbb{C}$ by the elementary symmetric functions $a_1, \dots, a_n$ of $x_1, \dots, x_n$.
nodes.title: The trivial descent

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $E = \mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ be the field of rational functions in $n$ indeterminates and let $F = \mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n) \subseteq E$ be the coefficient field of the general polynomial, where $a_k$ is the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$. A pair $(F_0, E_0)$ of intermediate fields of $\mathbb{C} \subseteq E$ is a descent when $F_0 \subseteq F$,…
nodes.title: Descent of the general polynomial extension

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $E_n = \mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$, let $a_k$ be the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$, let $F_n = \mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n) \subseteq E_n$ be the coefficient field, and let $f_n = X^n - a_1 X^{n-1} + \cdots + (-1)^n a_n \in F_n[X]$ be the general polynomial. The subfield of $E_n$ generated over $F_n$ by all roots of $f_n$ in $E_n$ is $E_n$ itself.
nodes.title: The roots of the general polynomial generate the function field

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the elements $x_1, \dots, x_n$ of the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ are pairwise distinct: $x_i = x_j$ implies $i = j$.
nodes.title: The roots $x_i$ are pairwise distinct

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $E_n = \mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$, let $a_k$ be the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$, and let $f_n = X^n - a_1 X^{n-1} + \cdots + (-1)^n a_n$ be the general polynomial, with coefficients in $F_n = \mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n) \subseteq E_n$. Then $f_n(x_i) = 0$ in $E_n$ for every $i \in \{1, \dots, n\}$.
nodes.title: Each $x_i$ is a root of the general polynomial

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and $i \in \{1, \dots, n\}$, $x_i$ is the $i$-th indeterminate of the polynomial ring $\mathbb{C}[x_1, \dots, x_n]$, viewed as an element of its fraction field, the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$.
nodes.title: The roots $x_i$

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ is the fraction field of the polynomial ring $\mathbb{C}[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ in $n$ indeterminates.
nodes.title: The function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the polynomial $\prod_{i=1}^{n} (X - x_i)$ over the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ is separable.
nodes.title: The product of the linear factors $X - x_i$ is separable

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $a_k$ be the $k$-th elementary symmetric function of $x_1, \dots, x_n$ in $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$. The coefficient field $F_n = \mathbb{C}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of the general polynomial has numeric transcendence degree $n$ over $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Transcendence degree of the coefficient field

nodes.summary: For a field $F$ that is a $\mathbb{C}$-algebra, the numeric transcendence degree of $F$ is its transcendence degree over $\mathbb{C}$ as a natural number when that degree is finite, and $0$ when it is infinite.
nodes.title: Numeric transcendence degree

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the function field $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ has transcendence degree $n$ over $\mathbb{C}$, as a cardinal.
nodes.title: Transcendence degree of $\mathbb{C}(x_1, \dots, x_n)$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
